body:
I tried this for the first time and wasn't sure what to expect. I'm a heavy cannabis user so I expected little to no effect.
I packed a bowl after separating stems from the catnip. It was probably about 1.5 grams of catnip in the bowl. At 6:05AM I quickly shotgunned the bong in about 4 hits. 6:15AM I began to feel a warmth in my muscles, not like opiates I have tried tons of opiates and this was on the muscles not all over. 6:20AM I feel calm, mildly euphoric. 6:25AM I roll a joint of catnip and begin smoking it. 6:28AM The joint is almost done and I feel pretty good actually, really relaxed with no real aches or pains.
Overall I'm pleasantly surprised it was a decent herb for anxiety or muscle aches. It doesn't replace bud but it does calm me down.
